description: This file defines service functions for managing gym classes and sessions, including creation, update, deletion, and listing operations, interacting with SQLAlchemy ORM models.

methods.name: Class create_class(db: Session, title: str, description: str | None, capacity: int)
methods.description: Creates a new gym class with specified title, description, and capacity, adds it to the database, and returns the created Class object.

methods.name: Class update_class(db: Session, class_id: int, **fields)
methods.description: Updates fields of an existing class identified by class_id; raises ValueError if class not found.

methods.name: None delete_class(db: Session, class_id: int)
methods.description: Deletes an existing class identified by class_id; raises ValueError if class not found.

methods.name: list[Class] list_classes(db: Session)
methods.description: Retrieves all classes from the database.

methods.name: ClassSession create_session(db: Session, class_id: int, start_time: datetime, end_time: datetime, capacity: int)
methods.description: Creates a new class session with given start and end times, capacity, and initializes spots_remaining; raises ValueError if class not found or if end_time is not after start_time.

methods.name: list[ClassSession] list_sessions(db: Session, class_id: int | None = None)
methods.description: Lists all class sessions, optionally filtered by class_id, ordered by start_time ascending.

ctags.name: create_class
ctags.pattern: /^def create_class(db: Session, title: str, description: str | None, capacity: int) -> Class:$/
ctags.signature: (db: Session, title: str, description: str | None, capacity: int)

ctags.name: create_session
ctags.pattern: /^def create_session(db: Session, class_id: int, start_time: datetime, end_time: datetime, capacit/
ctags.signature: (db: Session, class_id: int, start_time: datetime, end_time: datetime, capacity: int)

ctags.name: list_sessions
ctags.pattern: /^def list_sessions(db: Session, class_id: int | None = None) -> list[ClassSession]:$/
